title: Fourier–Mukai transform
html: Fourier–Mukai transform. For smooth projective varieties X, Y and an object K of D^{b}(X \times Y), the functor \Phi_{K} \colon D^{b}(X) \to D^{b}(Y), E \mapsto Rp_{Y*}\bigl(p_{X}^{*}E \otimes^{L} K\bigr): pull back along the projection to X, tensor with the kernel K, push forward along the projection to Y. By Orlov's theorem [orlov1997] every fully faithful exact functor between such categories is a Fourier–Mukai transform with a unique kernel; the name records that the transform with kernel the Poincaré bundle on an abelian variety and its dual is the analogue of the Fourier transform.
